verdict.rationale: Sardine's marketing pages say its AI agents auto-clear obvious or low-risk sanctions matches and route higher-risk matches for analyst review with explainable scores [sardine-docs-18, sardine-docs-21]. Analysts handle escalated items in a Case Management workspace [sardine-docs-26], and alert reviews are automated by 'audit-ready agents' [sardine-docs-28]. Nothing documents how customers set policy limits on what the agents may auto-resolve; adjustable fuzzy-match thresholds [sardine-docs-12] are only an adjacent control. Missing for 10: documented policy controls bounding agent auto-clearing, configurable escalation criteria for ambiguous findings, technical docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
